scenes.headline: How Datadog taught a small model to chase outages
scenes.sub: Simulated incidents, a sandboxed toolset and asynchronous reinforcement learning.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Carillon! When a pager goes off, someone has to work out why. Datadog trained a model to do that.

scenes.text: Inject a fault into a simulated system, and the fault you injected becomes the answer key the agent is rewarded against.
scenes.say: Real incidents have no clean labels. So simulate the system, inject a fault, and the fault you injected is the answer key.

scenes.title: Building one training incident
scenes.say: Their simulator builds each training incident in four moves.

items.say: An agent turns a real postmortem into a blueprint of the causal chain.
Another agent builds a working system from it, or writes the telemetry directly.
The fault is injected, and an alert fires.
It is kept only if solvable, leak-free, and still hard.

steps.say: The model gets the alert and tries the same incident several times.
Each try queries a sandboxed copy of the real production tools.
The diagnosis is scored for being right, and for claims the evidence supports.
Tries are compared within the group, and new weights flow back as rollouts keep running.

scenes.title: Why the reward took many tries

left.title: Train on the eval judge
left.say: Training on the evaluation judge alone backfired. The model learned to claim less.

right.title: The hybrid reward
items: Then claim only what it supports
right.say: The reward that worked pays for chasing evidence, then for supported claims.

steps.say: On their internal benchmark, quality is plotted against cost.
Scout at its highest effort matches Claude Fable five point one at its highest effort, at about a quarter of the cost.

scenes.title: SREGym, 90 public faults
scenes.note: one attempt per fault, so the top rows tie
scenes.say: On the public SREGym benchmark, Scout climbs into the top group. With one attempt per fault, those rows tie.

scenes.text: Make the injected fault the label, train in the real harness, and never train on your evaluation judge alone.
scenes.mark: never train on your evaluation judge alone

scenes.say: To recap: injected faults as labels, sandboxed real tools, and a reward that pays for evidence.
